scope.description: Platforms that let merchants run their own branded commerce (storefront, checkout, orders, payments and point of sale) rather than sell inside a marketplace, plus marketplaces as the main substitute for merchant demand.
inclusionLogic: commerce platforms competing for the same SMB, scaling-brand or enterprise merchants
point-of-sale vendors competing for unified retail merchants
composable and licensed enterprise commerce suites that premium merchants replatform from
marketplaces that substitute for an owned store
notes: Business stats come from company filings and investor press releases; one Commerce.com figure set is cited from a syndicated copy of the company's press release.
GMV, GTV and GPV definitions differ between companies and are not directly comparable; scope is preserved as reported.

Private companies (Squarespace, commercetools) and product lines inside larger groups (Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, WooCommerce, Square Online) do not publish comparable commerce metrics; they are included without stats.

players.name: Shopify
